# Nexus Apps

> Independent app studio in Berlin, Germany. Mobile app, web application and MVP development for startups and businesses worldwide.

Nexus Apps builds and operates six in-house iOS apps. These products demonstrate its product and interface work. Its published portfolio is not commissioned Android or web client work.

## Development services

- [Mobile app development](https://nexusapps.co/services/mobile-app-development/): Build an iOS or Android app for your customers or team. We work with you on the scope, interface and development through testing and store submission.
- [Web app development](https://nexusapps.co/services/web-app-development/): Build a web application for your customers or team. We plan the workflows, design a responsive interface and develop the backend and integrations your product needs.
- [MVP development](https://nexusapps.co/services/mvp-development/): A minimum viable product (MVP) is a first release focused on testing a product idea with real users. We agree on what you need to learn, choose the essential features and build a mobile or web release.

## Work with the studio

- [Our process](https://nexusapps.co/process/): Product discovery, scope, design, development, testing, launch and ongoing maintenance.
- [About us](https://nexusapps.co/about/): The independent studio and its in-house product background.
- [Contact](https://nexusapps.co/contact/): Discuss a mobile app, web product or MVP. Email hello@nexusapps.co with your idea, intended users, existing materials and timing.

## In-house iOS portfolio

- [Our apps](https://nexusapps.co/apps/): Six products built, published and maintained by Nexus Apps.
- [Visual LabX](https://nexusapps.co/apps/visuallabx/): Photo editing with creative presets, film-inspired filters and retouching tools.
- [Photo CamAI](https://nexusapps.co/apps/photocamai/): An iPhone photo editor with one-tap enhancements powered by on-device AI.
- [Wallpapers Neo](https://nexusapps.co/apps/wallpapers/): A curated wallpaper collection with categories, favorites and text customization.
- [Retro Cam Neo](https://nexusapps.co/apps/retrocamneo/): A vintage camera with real-time film looks, adjustable grain and light leaks.
- [Clear Wave Pro](https://nexusapps.co/apps/clearwave/): Speaker cleaning modes, stereo testing and a real-time sound meter in one utility.
- [ASO Rocket](https://nexusapps.co/apps/asorocket/): An App Store keyword tool for discovering ideas, organizing lists and preparing metadata.
